methodology.summary: The Patch combines reviewed benchmark anchors with tracker-backed calculator lanes. Per-pet review dates identify the anchors checked most recently.
notes: 37 benchmark anchors were reviewed on November 8, 2026. 64 anchors retain earlier values because an independent check was unavailable or disagreed.
Reviewed pets use Adopt Me Values variant lanes. The supporting independent check matches the same Fly Ride or No Potion variant.
Values can move quickly. New pets stay pending where sources materially disagree.
